summary: Leidos closed the previously announced April 14, 2026 Contribution and Equity Purchase Agreement, contributing its Security Enterprise Solutions and Industrial Automation businesses into a new joint venture, Nickel JV Ultimate Parent, LLC, alongside Altaris affiliates holding Analogic Corporation. Leidos Inc. received 41.5% of JV equity; AHP Entities received 58.5%, with part of Analogic Holding sold for cash funded by new JV debt financing. AHP appoints a board majority and holds majority voting power; Leidos designates a minority. Closing occurred October 5, 2026; no per-share price or termination fee disclosed. Watch JV governance, debt terms, and any Leidos monetization of its minority stake.
